question: Compute the Karl Pearson Coefficient of Skewness for the data given here 27, 3, 28, 40, 28, 30, 35, 27, 25, 27?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the Mean and Mode of the given data set.

Sum of observations = 270 | Number of observations = 10 | Mean = 270 ÷ 10 = 27.

Mode is the most frequent value. In this set, 27 appears 3 times, which is the highest frequency.

Karl Pearson Coefficient of Skewness = (Mean − Mode) ÷ Standard Deviation.

Since Mean (27) = Mode (27), the numerator is 0, making the coefficient 0.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**
